test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.**

He is (**frank**) about what he sees as the shortcomings of his great predecessors.
solution: The correct answer is **"evasive."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence talks about someone being honest and open about the shortcomings of their predecessors. • **"Frank"** means showing your thoughts and feelings clearly; saying what you mean. (विचारों और भावों को स्‍पष्‍टता से व्‍यक्त करते हुए; अभीष्‍ट का अभिव्‍यंजक; स्‍पष्‍टकारी) • **Example**: *To be perfectly **frank**__ with you, I don’t think you’ll pass your driving test.* • The antonym of **"frank" **would be a word that means the opposite of honest or open. • **"Evasive" **fits this description, as it means avoiding giving a direct answer or being unclear about something. (टालमटोल वाला; घुमा-फिरा कर कहा गया) __ • **Example**: *Anu gave an **evasive**__ answer.* • The correct answer is option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Assisting**: means to help or support someone. (सहायता करना) • **Cheerful**: means being happy and optimistic. (प्रसन्‍न, प्रमुदित; हँसमुख) • **Fortunate**: means lucky or having good fortune. (भाग्‍यशाली) 1f0:Tba5, The correct answer is **"commensurate."**
